canonical_determination: After 10 consecutive hours off, driving is limited to 11 hours and may not continue past the 14th consecutive hour after coming on duty. A 30-minute break is required after eight cumulative driving hours unless a qualifying short-haul exemption applies.

canonical_overrides.authoritative_rule: Maximum driving is 11 hours after 10 consecutive hours off. A driver may not drive after the 14th consecutive hour after coming on duty; off-duty time does not extend that window. A driver may not drive after 70 on-duty hours in eight consecutive days unless a valid 34-hour restart resets the cycle. A 30-minute break is required after eight cumulative driving hours and may be satisfied by off-duty, sleeper-berth, on-duty-not-driving time, or a qualifying combination; qualifying short-haul drivers are exempt from that break requirement.

The 16-hour exception requires the stated return history and frequency limits. Adverse conditions must be unexpected, unforeseeable, and unknown at dispatch and may extend the applicable time by up to two hours without allowing more than 11 driving hours or driving past the 16th consecutive hour.

The 16-hour exception requires return to the reporting location for the required duty-tour history; CDL drivers may use it once in seven consecutive days unless reset by 34 hours off, while non-CDL drivers may use it twice in seven days. The adverse-driving-conditions exception applies only to unexpected, unforeseeable hazardous conditions unknown at dispatch and may add up to two hours without permitting more than 11 driving hours or driving past the 16th consecutive hour after coming on duty.
